title: Weekly WhatsApp reminders to customers who owe you
summary: Every week, send each customer on your debtors sheet an approved WhatsApp reminder.
description: Once a week, reads your debtors list from a Google Sheet (columns: name, whatsapp, amount_owed) and sends each customer who still owes money your approved WhatsApp reminder template, filled with their name, the amount and your business name. WhatsApp only allows approved templates for messages a customer did not start, so create the template in WhatsApp Manager first. At most five messages go out at a time.

params.name: business_name
params.title: Business name
params.description: Filled into the template's third variable.

params.name: spreadsheet_id
params.title: Debtors spreadsheet
params.description: The spreadsheet's id, from its link.

params.name: sheet_range
params.title: Sheet and columns
params.description: Where the list is, with a header row of name, whatsapp and amount_owed.

params.name: template_name
params.title: WhatsApp template
params.description: The name of your approved reminder template, with body variables for name, amount and business.

params.name: day
params.title: Day
params.description: The day of the week the reminders go out.

params.name: send_time
params.title: Time
params.description: The time the reminders go out, Lagos time.

params.name: whatsapp_connection
params.title: WhatsApp connection
params.description: The name of your WhatsApp Business connection.

params.name: sheets_connection
params.title: Google Sheets connection
params.description: The name of your Google Sheets connection.

definition.name: Weekly WhatsApp reminders to customers who owe

steps.name: Use your business name and template
For each customer on the sheet
Send the customer the WhatsApp reminder
steps.when: =has(item.whatsapp) && item.whatsapp != null && has(item.amount_owed) && item.amount_owed != null && double(item.amount_owed) > 0.0
